Title: US Government Bandwidth Data Transfer In and Out GUID migration

Body.Content:
Effective December 1, 2018, the resource GUIDs for Azure Bandwidth Data Transfer In and Out US Government will change. The resource GUID changes will affect the resource GUID naming. These changes will not affect any pricing, but you might need to modify billing routines that rely on names and resource GUIDs.

See the following table for details about the resource GUID and name changes.
